scope: packaging only: freeze the clef-distill-v2 D4 seed-1 INT8 encoder (type + target) together with the unchanged rule-based value parser (gidi.value_parser) and the whole-word target snap into one release. No training, no seed change, no architecture/tokenizer/vocabulary change, no threshold change, no special-casing of any note. models/gidi-finance-v1..v3 are not modified. Released by explicit user decision although the pre-set D4 success criterion was missed narrowly (see experiments/clef-distill-v2/report.md, D4 verdict).
architecture: clef-distill-v2 D4 seed 1: compression-v3 recipe (pretrained BamiBERT-derived 4x768 encoder, layers 2,5,8,11, FFN 2048 combined criterion, 34 position rows, vocabulary B-rank-8000 with 8,338 tokens, max_length 32), supervised with hard labels on training-v7-d4 (training-v5 + silver-A + augment-01 + annotation-v4 rule notes from the Clef teacher); type head (8 classes) + target BIO head, ONNX INT8 (dynamic, QInt8 weights). Same ONNX interface and runtime contract as gidi-finance-v3 (value span from gidi.value_parser, whole-word target snap).

seed_selection.rule: seed 1, the candidate pre-declared in experiments/clef-distill-v2/protocol.json (key d4) before any D4 model existed; not chosen among seeds 1-3 by any held-out score. The user accepted it knowing the D4 success criterion was missed (probe-rules-v1 gain +0.047 vs +0.10 needed; human-value-02 end-to-end -0.021 vs arm A seed 1).

value_decoding_rule: none: no value head. The value span is gidi.value_parser.parse_value(text) (offsets in code points of the caller's string, None when the note holds no amount); Prediction value_confidence is null because the rule parser has no score.
target_snap_rule: the decoded first target span is extended outward to whole words (maximal non-whitespace runs, edge punctuation of the extension trimmed), exactly gidi.inference.decode.snap_to_words; member tokens, and therefore target_confidence, are unchanged.
evaluation_sets_report_only: frozen test, probe-v1, probe-rules-v1, human-value-01 and human-value-02 are used only to report quality. Numbers: experiments/clef-distill-v2/results-d4.json, report.md.
thresholds: none; confidences are uncalibrated scores, abstention policy is left to a later calibration phase
acceptance_gate: bundle reproducible (freeze_deployment --check byte-identical); every bundle file matches manifest.json
INT8 model is the ONNX the D4 held-out runs scored
release verify passes: hashes, runtime config, INT8 and FP32 smoke predictions
on_gate_failure: stop and report the blocker; no retraining, no seed change
